## Pruna P-Video-2 Pro Reference to Video

A prompt plus references becomes a new clip that keeps the identity, wardrobe, style or soundtrack
of what you feed it.

### How to use

1. Sign in with your ComfyUI account. This is an API node, it bills per second of rendered video.
2. Connect one to nine reference images, up to three reference videos and up to three audio clips
   (12 references in total). References are addressed in the prompt by connection order:
   `@Image1`…`@Image9`, `@Video1`…`@Video3`, `@Audio1`…`@Audio3`.
3. Write the prompt with those tags, e.g. "the character from @Image1 walks through the place from
   @Image2". Keep `enhance_prompt` on `turbo` when the prompt refers to numbered references.
4. `first_frame` / `last_frame` pin the opening or closing image instead of only referencing it.
   `keep_audio` needs exactly one connected audio clip and uses it as the soundtrack.
5. `duration` is 5–14 seconds. `resolution` at 1080p, 2k or 4k upscales the 768p render, and `mode`
   trades speed for cost.

## Report Issue

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
